browser.diagnosticScope: Fixed error-category observer; no debugger. GUI wall time only, not isolated proof performance.
browser.proofTimingScope: GUI elapsed includes preparation and submission; fixed prover method-entry phases observed without changing arguments or returned promises.
browser.scope: Actual GUI post from preseeded disposable funded wallet; parent must verify canonical node effects. Not a full deposit-to-withdraw journey.

worker.profile: application transaction proofs with official local protocol fixture and controlled settlement

board.scope: real client deployment transaction proof and node admission validation only
board.initializerVisibility: public; client proof authenticates private account/transaction path
board.nextRequired: Submit this exact in-memory tx, observe inclusion, then use official test settlement before local Ready activation.

inclusion.clockProfile: controlled disposable L1 mining and node clock synchronization; no throughput/finality claim

ready.scope: disabled portal deployment and genuine update_portal client proof
ready.nextRequired: Include exact binding tx; require SUCCESS and actual Ready leaf, official test settlement of the emitted message before local portal activation.

readyInclusion.clockProfile: controlled disposable L1 mining and node clock synchronization; no throughput/finality claim

settlement.scope: controlled test settlement, test-controlled Ready membership and enabled portal

localSettlement.scope: local storage forced by official test helpers; neither epoch proof nor economic finality

clientMining.clockSynchronization: every mined block, including correction of wall-clock lead

privateFee.scope: native cold-start claim and independently verified browser private-balance post

claim.scope: local real deposit and genuine private claim with ordinary checkpoint inclusion

replay.stage: PXE witness generation; no second proof accepted or transaction sent

claim.nextRequired: Wait eligibility; prove/include no-post exit, then use official test Outbox settlement and withdraw L1.

feeExhaustion.stage: actual private balance preparation; no proof or submission

publicFootprint.scope: Exact known-role equality in named public transaction/effect fields; no witness or decrypted-note inspection
publicFootprint.matching: Whole field numeric equality; no substring scan; commitments and delivery matches do not decode identities
publicFootprint.limits: Does not test derived identifiers, linkability across transactions, funding timing, RPC metadata, proof bytes, protocol constants or contract-class contents. Private delivery tags/payload are public serialized fields, not decrypted private data. Absence of exact matches is not proof of anonymity.

verification.scope: one genuine browser-proved first post; native fixture preparation and read-only verification
